clue.text: (To be deduced)

parts.note: surface reading: the clue openly says the solver must work this entry out unaided
setter's reading: the theme entries referring to this one are all places in Ukraine, so the shared category is what is being deduced

explanation.walkthrough: There is no wordplay: once a few of the clues referring to 1 are solved (KYIV, LVIV, ODESA), the common thread gives this entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Kyiv, Lviv, Odesa, Kharkiv, Donetsk and Dnipro are all large Ukrainian urban centres, so the thematic word is a general term for them.

clue.text: Put out teapot as an improvement

indicators.note: something put out is disturbed from its place, so the preceding word is rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
an urn is a large vessel for making and serving tea

explanation.surface: Someone sets out the teapot, and things are looking up.
explanation.definitionFit: An upward turn in fortunes or trade is a rise or recovery, the noun sense of getting better.

clue.text: In combat dress left crew area

indicators.note: one letter is placed in, that is inside, the word for combat

parts.note: a fight is combat

to deck (out) is to dress or adorn

explanation.walkthrough: 'Combat dress' reads as a single military phrase, but the two words are separate pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: On an aircraft the cockpit, where the pilots work, is called the flight deck; on a carrier it is where aircraft land and take off.

clue.text: Seize scarf almost covering sides of cloak

indicators.note: the sides of a word are its two outermost letters

explanation.definitionFit: To hijack is to take control of a vehicle or thing by force, so it is a synonym for grabbing it.

clue.text: Leash may upset pet

indicators.note: upset means knocked over or thrown into disorder, so the letters before it are jumbled

parts.note: the letters of both words

explanation.surface: A dog on a lead might be unsettled by it.
explanation.walkthrough: A Sealyham is a small white Welsh terrier.
explanation.definitionFit: This breed of terrier is kept as a companion dog, so it is a specific example of a household animal.

clue.text: 1, large and very bright, I had to leave

clue.text: Priest welcomes one very able to bring recovery

indicators.note: a host who welcomes guests takes them inside, so the clergy word encloses the others

I is the Roman numeral for one
V is the abbreviation for very

explanation.surface: A priest welcomes a talented parishioner who can help someone get well.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Very able' looks like a phrase describing the one being welcomed; 'very' is only a letter and 'able' belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something curative heals or remedies illness, so it has the power to make a patient well again.

clue.text: Excited cry as a Turner is slashed

indicators.note: something slashed is cut short, so the word loses its final letter

parts.note: a wheel is something that turns

explanation.surface: Gallery visitors gasp as a painting by J. M. W. Turner is vandalised with a knife.
explanation.walkthrough: The capital T makes us think of the painter Turner; here it is just anything that turns.

clue.text: Rash is revolting: at first I'm scratching endless red

indicators.note: at first places the new pair of letters at the front of the word
scratching means crossing out, so the named letters are struck off and replaced
endless means without its final letter, so the colour word is shortened

parts.note: revolting and repulsive are synonyms
taken as written
taken as written, before trimming

explanation.surface: A skin rash looks revolting: the itchy patient starts scratching the red spots.
explanation.walkthrough: Rash is the definition, not a skin complaint: the opening RE of the long word for revolting is swapped for IM.
explanation.definitionFit: Rash as an adjective means acting hastily without thought, which is what an impetuous, spur-of-the-moment person does.

clue.text: Answer for coupon clipped twice

indicators.note: clipped means trimmed at the end, and twice means it happens two times, so two final letters go

clue.text: Inexperienced solvers no good

parts.note: the setter addresses the solvers as you

clue.text: Relieve a person from Genesis recently confined

explanation.walkthrough: Genesis could be the rock band; here it is the first book of the Bible.
explanation.definitionFit: To alleviate pain or suffering is to lessen or ease it, so it is a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Finished job, not a 1

the letter to be removed

clue.text: Had some whiskies, then departs: where's the taxi?

a taxi rank is where cabs wait for passengers

explanation.definitionFit: Drank is the past tense of drink, and having had some whiskies means having consumed alcohol.

clue.text: Taking out horse coughing persistently and coping with it

definitions.meaning: first meaning: riding a horse out at an ordinary pace for pleasure
second meaning: a dry, repeated rasping cough
third meaning: in slang, managing or tolerating a situation

explanation.surface: A rider with a bad cough carries on hacking out regardless.
explanation.walkthrough: This is a triple definition. To hack is British riding usage for a leisurely ride out, and 'can't hack it' means can't cope.
explanation.definitionFit: The participle works as riding at an easy pace, as a description of a dry repeated cough, and as informal for managing a difficult situation.

clue.text: Daisy May, encountering a set-up, plays along

taken as written

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: Someone who cooperates works with others willingly instead of resisting, so they go along with the scheme.

clue.text: Takes hold of powerless informer

explanation.walkthrough: 'Powerless' reads as one word, but it splits into power, a letter, and less, the instruction to remove it.
explanation.definitionFit: In British slang a grass is someone who tells the police about criminals, a snitch.

clue.text: Frenchman's contribution to land reform

explanation.definitionFit: This is a common French male first name, so any man bearing it is an example of a Frenchman.

clue.text: Vigorous gardenia important for a healthy garden

definitions.note: a description of the answer rather than a synonym

indicators.note: vigorous suggests energetic movement, so the letters of the flower are shaken up

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Gardening advice: a vigorous gardenia is key to a thriving plot.
explanation.definitionFit: Plants rot in waterlogged soil, so carrying excess water away from the ground is essential to keep a plot thriving.

clue.text: Nearly a title for mother

parts.note: Dame is a title given to a woman honoured in Britain

explanation.surface: A mother has almost been given an honour.
explanation.definitionFit: A dam is the female parent of an animal, especially a horse, so it is a breeding term for a mother.

clue.text: Club beginning to burn after gangsters turn up and swoop with explosives

parts.note: the first letter of burn
